audience.description: Who it is for. Empty when the user did not say.

briefId.description: Identifies the request this pack answers. A DeckPlan names it back.

goal.description: What the deck has to achieve, in one sentence.

items.description: Can be empty: a brief alone is a valid pack, and then nothing else may be cited.

itemId.description: What a sourceRef points at. Unique within the pack and stable across a run.

origin.description: File name or URL it came from. Empty when the user typed it in.

text.description: The material itself as plain text, in the form a quote can be taken from.

title.description: Heading of the passage. Empty when it has none.

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the source material.
